_about: Upcoming features you can try in Test / Experimental mode (owner, moderators, devs). game: site | skibidi | blockworld. status: idea | building | testing.

experiments.name: Mobile touch controls
experiments.description: An on-screen move stick plus JUMP, RELOAD and FIRE buttons on the Play page, for phones and tablets. The buttons send the same keys as a keyboard; the game itself still has to listen for them.

experiments.name: Music tab
experiments.description: A Music button on every page that opens the soundtrack list, with every track credited to its creator.

experiments.name: Far terrain (LOD)
experiments.description: Distant Horizons-style far chunks: full detail near you, cheap low-detail blocks far away, so the view distance can go way up without killing FPS. Try the sliders on the Blockworld page.

experiments.name: Day / night sky
experiments.description: The Blockworld page sky slowly cycles from day to sunset to night, like the game's day/night cycle.
